lines.text: The star Wormwood fell on a third of the rivers, and a lion cried woe over the last three trumpets.

problems.problem: Its true detail "three more trumpets" isn't in Revelation 8:13 word for word.
Its wrong detail "two more trumpets" isn't found anywhere in the Bible.
Its true detail "three more trumpets" isn't in the Prep cards, so the walkthrough didn't teach it.
